If needed, each taxi and landing light must be designed and installed so that
(a) If a sensor is required for taxi, take-off or landing phase then there should be no dangerous glare from taxi and landing lights that would affect UAV operational safety.
(b) Not applicable
(c) It provides enough light for all intended operations; and
(d) It does not cause a fire hazard in any configuration.
